declarations.docstring: An auxiliary type indexed by a natural number and two partitions of that number.
The number of cells whose auxiliary entry is below a bound equals the sum of the corresponding initial sorted parts.
The two partitions indexing an auxiliary object satisfy the displayed relation.
The auxiliary cardinal quantity for a partition paired with itself is one.
The auxiliary cardinal quantity equals the cardinality of the corresponding auxiliary type.
The auxiliary cardinal quantity is zero when the displayed partition relation fails.
An equivalence between the auxiliary partition-indexed type and a finite type of the corresponding auxiliary cardinality.
Each auxiliary partition-indexed type is finite.
On a diagonal pair of partitions, the displayed auxiliary natural-number value equals the auxiliary cardinal quantity.
When the displayed relation fails, the displayed auxiliary natural-number value equals the auxiliary cardinal quantity.
